## Tidepool Landing Page — Build Plan

**Global treatment:** Palette — deep teal (#0E3B43), seafoam (#7FD1C1), warm sand (#F7F1E6), coral accent (#FF6F61). Type: Fraunces (serif) headlines, Inter body. Rounded 12px corners, generous whitespace, subtle wave motifs throughout.

**1. Sticky nav** — Logo left; anchors (Product, Method, Pricing); coral "Start free" pill right. Sand background, thin border.

**2. Hero** — Two-column: left, copy; right, animated product screenshot of a shared weekly board. H1: *"Plan the week together, in one calm place."* Subhead: *"Tidepool replaces status meetings with a 15-minute weekly rhythm your whole team can feel."* Primary CTA: "Start your first week"; secondary: "See a live example." Background: soft animated wave gradient.

**3. Proof strip** — Slim bar: "2,400+ small teams plan here" + five muted grayscale logos.

**4. Pain statement** — Pure typography, centered, oversized serif: *"Your team doesn't need another meeting. It needs a rhythm."* One supporting sentence below. No imagery — a breathing pause.

**5. How it works** — Three equal cards with line illustrations: **Monday check-in** (set priorities), **Midweek pulse** (async updates), **Friday wrap** (reflect, reset). Micro-copy under each, ~15 words.

**6. Feature bento** — Asymmetric 2×2 grid of screenshot fragments: shared priorities, async updates, capacity view, Slack + Calendar integrations. Each tile one benefit headline, one line of copy.

**7. Signature moment** — Full-width dark teal section: horizontal scroll-animated timeline of a real team's week, populated with believable content (names, tasks, emojis). Caption: *"One week in Tidepool."*

**8. Testimonial** — Single quote on sand, headshot left: *"We cancelled three recurring meetings in week one."* — PM, 6-person startup.

**9. Pricing tease** — One card only: "Free up to 5 people. $4/seat after."

**10. Final CTA** — Email capture over a wave illustration. H2: *"Make next week the calm one."*

**11. Footer** — Three link columns, tiny tide-pool illustration, copyright.

## Tidepool Landing Page — Revised Build Plan

**What I'm taking from the library page:** the vertical week-timeline (a structural gift for a weekly-planning product), the hand-drawn annotation layer, the coral-on-deep-green palette family, and the monospace pull quote. **What I'm leaving:** the 40-word breathless headline — wrong register for a "calm" product. Instead I'll steal its *payoff specificity* ("nobody forgets the milk again") in compact form.

**Global treatment:** Palette holds at deep teal (#0E3B43), seafoam (#7FD1C1), sand (#F7F1E6), coral (#FF6F61) — the library validates deep-green-plus-coral; I keep the oceanic hue because the name demands it. Type: Fraunces headlines, Inter body, plus JetBrains Mono as a third voice for anything that reads like a logged update. Coral hand-drawn annotation layer throughout.

**1. Sticky nav** — Logo left; anchors (Product, Method, Pricing); coral "Start free" pill. Sand background.

**2. Hero** — Two-column: copy left, animated shared-board screenshot right. H1 stays short: *"Plan the week together, in one calm place."* Subhead gains the library's concreteness: *"A 15-minute Monday check-in, a midweek pulse, a Friday wrap — so nobody ever has to ask 'what are you working on?' again."* Hand-drawn coral arrow curls from headline to screenshot, annotated *"your whole week, live."* Small sketched circles flag key UI elements.

**3. Proof strip** — "2,400+ small teams plan here" + five muted logos.

**4. Pain statement** — Oversized centered serif: *"Your team doesn't need another meeting. It needs a rhythm."* Now sets up the next section.

**5. How it works — revised** — The library's timeline device, where it's structurally earned: a vertical week-timeline runs down the left (wavy connector, **Mon → Wed → Fri** nodes), ritual content alternating right. The page literally embodies the rhythm it sells.

**6. Feature bento** — Asymmetric 2×2: shared priorities, async updates, capacity view, integrations. Update tiles set in monospace, previewing the log texture.

**7. Signature moment** — Dark teal, horizontally scrollable *"One week in Tidepool"*: a real-feeling team's week with names, tasks, monospace async updates. Section 5 is the abstract rhythm; this is the lived week.

**8. Testimonial** — Headshot left; quote set in monospace on sand: *"We cancelled three recurring meetings in week one."*

**9. Pricing tease** — One card: "Free up to 5 people. $4/seat after."

**10. Final CTA** — Email capture over wave illustration: *"Make next week the calm one."*

**11. Footer** — Link columns, tide-pool mark, copyright.
